key_point: Sonic was first designed as a rabbit that grabbed things with its ears
title: Sonic was almost a rabbit who threw things with his ears.
caption: Sonic was almost a rabbit who threw things with his ears. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #sonic #sega #retrogaming

instagram.caption:
Sonic was almost a rabbit who threw things with his ears.

Sega tested that idea first, but stopping to pick things up slowed the game down.

The team wanted a hero who attacks just by moving. So they chose an animal that rolls into a ball: first an armadillo, then a hedgehog.

What was your first Sonic game?
